Name: Market Stall Traveling Merchant
Author: AirynS
Description:
This is a simple mod that changes the look of the travelling merchant’s wagon so that it instead looks like a two-wheeled cart with a market stall table set up beside it. It was made as a gift for Nachtigall on the [url=https://diversestardewvalley.weebly.com/]Diverse Stardew Valley[/url] server, as she asked if there were any retextures to make the travelling merchant’s wagon look less like a Romani vardo.
[b]
[size=4]Configuration[/size]:[/b]

Market Stall Travelling Merchant has one config option:
[u]
[/u][b]RoofColour[/b]: This option chooses whether the merchant’s roof is the vanilla mint green or white.[b]

[size=4]Compatibility[/size]:[/b]

Market Stall Travelling Merchant is compatible with the `JustTheBoar` option of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2113]Rustic Traveling Cart[/url], but not the other options for obvious reasons. The regular seasonal version of the merchant should be compatible with various recolours, but the Night Market version may have graphical errors as it hasn’t been tested.

(Note: there is a minor graphical error when the merchant closes for the night where a black box for the “empty window” is overlaid onto the  table, which is unable to be fixed. Thank you to Riazaia for the information about it!)
